service.clear.explain: Clears this service's cache and site data: HTTP cache, localStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage and service workers. Cookies and other services are left alone. A service that keeps its sign-in in localStorage will sign you out of it. Its service worker is removed, so web push notifications that depend on it need subscribing again.
